en: Heh. So you only looked strong, didn't you?
Grr, you're running away?! Coward...
That's a ninja for you. So quick to run away...
So the wretch ran off! Nothing but talk!
So they ran off... Well, no matter.
note: Subject restored as "they" (the fled opponent, gender unknown).

en: So the wretch ran off. Nothing but talk.
note: Same as I0486 with a period (the Japanese differs only by 。 vs ！).

en: Lost their nerve...? Heh. With skill like that, no wonder.
Ha ha ha! They turned tail and ran!
Lost their nerve? Hmph. No surprise, with that skill.
Is that the end of it, then?
Quitting halfway through? I can't say I approve.
Young lord, have you hurt yourself?
I very nearly lost to you, young lord.
You're running away?! ...No, I won't chase too far.
Whew, that was close... That saved my hide.
Whew, that was close... Seems I've been spared.
Why did you run? I was the one losing...
I'd have said they had the upper hand...
Why did you run? We were only just getting started...
I came awfully close to losing there.
That kunoichi is quite skilled.
Fled or not, that kunoichi is more skilled than I am.
Pathetic. And you call yourself a Mouri clan samurai?
Whew... That was a near thing.
Looks like I managed to win, somehow.
You're quite skilled, I must say.
That was good practice. You have my thanks.
That was a hard-fought match.
Seems I just about held out. ...Good grief.
Fearsome skill. I never thought I'd win.
...That was a formidable opponent.
That was a highly skilled opponent.
Ngh... To think you'd push me this far...
Whew, that was close.
You're quite skilled too, but no match for me.
Fool... Can you not even see the gap in our skill?
I can't afford to lose that easily!
The win is mine. Well, don't let it get you down.
You still lack discipline. Keep at your training.
Skill like that is no match for me. Is there no one else?
You were ten years too early to take me on.
Well then, who's next?!
...Weak! You need more training!
You fool! You dared to face me with skill like that?!
I win! Don't you think you need more training?
Looks like you'd better hone your skills some more.
Weak, so weak. You're no match for me.
I've wasted my time here.
Splendid. The fruit of your daily training, I take it?
I never dreamed you were this strong. Remarkable.
I had no idea you were so strong. I'm truly impressed.
Hmm... I never thought I'd lose to you, young lord.
I-I merely let my guard down a little, that's all.
You've grown strong yourself, young lord.
Hm, you really are strong. My training still falls short.
I thought I was close to winning...
Just as I thought. That one's quite skilled, it seems.
Ninja are strong...
note: Leading blank line kept (the Japanese record starts with a line break).

en: Blast it! Beaten by a mere ninja!
Gah! Why?! Why did I lose?!
To lose to such a one... What a humiliation...
To be bested by a fellow kunoichi...
I shouldn't have lost to that opponent...
Blast, I got careless! Fight me again! Don't run!
I yield. I am utterly defeated.
I hope you'll spar with me again.
Impressive as ever, young lord. You're strong indeed.
I'm hardly fit to be your sparring partner, young lord.
Impressive, young lord. You really are strong.
So strong...
note: Leading blank line kept (the Japanese record starts with a line break).

en: Please... take me on as your pupil...
S-so this is a ninja. ...Impressive.
I should never have challenged a ninja.
Seems I still need more training myself.
Beaten by a fellow ninja... How galling.
Such strength! I can't hope to match it.
A kunoichi, eh... Not someone I'd want as an enemy.
We're both kunoichi, yet there's such a gap between us...
To think I'd lose... Who is that?
I'm impressed. I lost this bout, fair and square.
